Interface Economy

public interface Economy
The server's money, whichever plugin keeps it. The AtomicTempest plugins charge and pay through this, so they work with Coins or with any economy that VaultUnlocked offers (Ecotale, TheEconomy, EliteEssentials...). Get the one in use with Economies.get().

Amounts are whole numbers of the economy's smallest unit. Every call is safe from any thread. Give a reason with every change, a few words such as "Slot machine bet": economies that keep a history (Coins) show it to the player.
